name: vx5-preclass-consistency-guard-metrics-d1-d4-20270513-20270519
qualityPolicyNotes: Serial 51 (Checklist A) merges two independent 24.23 slices per the merge policy: (1) 24.23.1 classifier consistency guard - add wc_preclass_verify_hardcoded_consistency() that compares every hardcoded fast-path segment (IPv4: 255.255.255.255, 240/4, 0/8, 10/8, 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 224/4; IPv6: ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8, 2001:db8::/32, 2000::/3) against frozen full-path expectations and the generated table's longest-prefix view (family/cls/rir/reason/confidence; approved per-side deltas: 224/4 class special-vs-reserved, 2000::/3 confidence low-vs-medium, reason strings intentionally different granularity), fail-closing through the built-in selftest with [PRECLASS-CONSISTENCY] diagnostics; (2) 24.23.5 observability - one-shot [PRECLASS-METRICS] exit line counting classified-query observations by family/class/confidence, emitted only under --retry-metrics/--debug and styled like the existing [RETRY-METRICS*]/[DNS-CACHE-SUM] tags. No classification semantics change; stdout contract untouched. Generator-side assertions and smoke greps live in scripts/docs and stay outside this closure.

D1.description: Introduce the classifier consistency guard: declare wc_preclass_verify_hardcoded_consistency() in the preclass header, add the stdio include required for its diagnostics, and append the frozen-expectation table plus the verify function at the end of preclass.c. The verify function cross-checks the full classify_ip path and the generated table longest-prefix view against frozen cls/rir/reason/confidence expectations for every hardcoded fast-path segment.

D2.description: Wire the consistency guard into the built-in selftest: add selftest_preclass_consistency() which fails the selftest run when any hardcoded segment drifts from the frozen contract, and invoke it at the head of wc_selftest_run().

D3.description: Add the [PRECLASS-METRICS] counter infrastructure: declare the record/enable/flush API in the preclass header and append the module-level counters plus the idempotent flush printer at the end of preclass.c. The flush prints one [PRECLASS-METRICS] line at process exit when enabled under --retry-metrics/--debug (zero counts allowed).

operations.pattern:
